message.content:
Based on the provided screenshots, here is a detailed analysis of the **Clinic 9** website pages:

### 1) About Us Page (من نحن)
*   **Layout:** Standard vertical layout with a large header image, text content on the right/left, and a footer.
*   **Content Sections:**
    *   **Header:** "من نحن" (About Us).
    *   **Main Body:** A descriptive text block detailing the clinic's history, mission, and values. It mentions being a specialized center for dermatology, laser, and beauty.
    *   **Footer:** Contains "قيمتنا" (Our Values), contact information (phone numbers), social media icons, and copyright info.
*   **UI Elements:** Text paragraphs, floating "WhatsApp" button with notification badge, sticky side menu for social media (Instagram, YouTube, etc.), and a promotional pop-up card in the corner offering a package deal ("2 sessions + 2 products...").
*   **Colors:** White background, light blue accents for buttons/headers (#7DC4DE approx.), dark grey text.

### 2) Shop/Services Page (المتجر / العروض)
*   **Layout:** E-commerce grid layout with a top filter bar, sidebar filters (on some variations), and product cards arranged in rows.
*   **Content Sections:**
    *   **Hero Banner:** Image of a woman receiving treatment with the title "العروض" (Offers) or "عروض" (Offers).
    *   **Filter Bar:** Categories like "الكل" (All), "بشرة" (Skin), "شعر" (Hair), etc., with counts. Price range slider.
    *   **Product Grid:** Cards displaying service/product images, titles (e.g., "3 جلسات ليزر..."), original price (strikethrough), sale price, and discount percentage badges (e.g., "-61%", "-28%").
*   **UI Elements:** Pagination at the bottom, sorting dropdown, category pills, and the persistent promotional pop-up.
*   **Colors:** Clean white cards, blue discount tags, light grey backgrounds for the page body.

### 3) Offers Page (عروض)
*   **Layout:** Identical to the Shop/Services page structure but specifically filtered or titled for "Offers".
*   **Content Sections:**
    *   Focuses heavily on discounted packages (e.g., Laser sessions, Botox units, Red Carpet facials).
    *   Displays "Best Seller" or "Most Popular" tags on certain items.
*   **UI Elements:** Same grid system as the shop page. The UI emphasizes the savings percentage visually with blue badges.
*   **Colors:** Consistent with the shop page; uses blue to highlight prices and discounts.

### 4) Contact Us Page (تواصل معنا)
*   **Layout:** Split layout or stacked layout containing a map placeholder and an information card.
*   **Content Sections:**
    *   **Map Area:** A large visual area (likely a map embed or image) showing location.
    *   **Info Card (Blue Background):** Titled "رؤيتنا للعالم" (Our Vision for the World) or Contact Info.
    *   **Details List:** Working hours for different days (Saturday to Thursday: 24.00 - 8.00), phone numbers, and email address.
*   **UI Elements:** Simple list format for hours, distinct blue container for contact details to separate it from the map.
*   **Colors:** Teal/Blue (#5BABC7 approx.) used for the information panel background.

### 5) Doctors Page (الأطباء)
*   **Layout:** Grid layout featuring profile cards for medical staff.
*   **Content Sections:**
    *   **Header:** "الأطباء" (Doctors) / "فريق العمل" (Team Work).
    *   **Doctor Cards:** Each card features a large portrait photo placeholder (light blue), Doctor's Name (e.g., "د. دينا محمود"), Title/Specialty (e.g., "أخصائية بشرة و laser"), and a brief bio/experience summary.
    *   **Action Button:** "احجز موعد" (Book Appointment) button on each card.
*   **UI Elements:** Carousel dots indicator at the bottom suggesting the cards might be part of a slider or just paginated content.
*   **Colors:** Light blue placeholders for images, white cards, blue action buttons.

### 6) News/Articles Page (الأخبار و المقالات)
*   **Layout:** Blog-style list or grid layout.
*   **Content Sections:**
    *   **Article Cards:** Features a "جديد حصرياً" (Exclusive New) tag.
    *   **Headlines:** Titles like "العناية بالبشرة في فصل الشتاء" (Skincare in Winter).
    *   **Metadata:** Author name (admin), read time (15 min read), date, and a short excerpt of the article text.
    *   **Link:** "قراءة المزيد" (Read More) link.
*   **UI Elements:** Minimalist text-based cards with tags for categorization.
*   **Colors:** White background, black text, blue accent for tags and links.

### 7) Jobs Page (وظائف)
*   **Layout:** Form-based layout divided into two main columns.
*   **Content Sections:**
    *   **Left Column (Contact Info):** Lists available job openings or contact methods (Address, Phone, Email) with copy icons next to them.
    *   **Right Column (Application Form):** Titled "قم بإرسال نموذج الوظيفة الآن" (Send Job Application Now). Fields include Name, Email, Phone, Message, and File Upload (CV upload).
*   **UI Elements:** Input fields with labels, file uploader button ("اختر الملف"), and a submit button ("إرسال").
*   **Colors:** Standard form styling with borders on inputs, blue submit button.

### 8) Cart Page (سلة المشتريات)
*   **Layout:** Centered empty state layout.
*   **Content Sections:**
    *   **Breadcrumb:** Home > Cart > Checkout.
    *   **Empty State Message:** Large icon of a shopping cart with an 'X'. Text reads "سلة مشترياتك فارغة حالياً." (Your shopping cart is currently empty).
    *   **Subtext:** Instruction to add products before proceeding to checkout.
    *   **Call to Action:** "متابعة التسوق" (Continue Shopping) button.
*   **UI Elements:** Large iconography to clearly communicate state.
*   **Colors:** Grey iconography, Blue CTA button.

### 9) Booking Page (حجز موعد)
*   **Layout:** Two-column layout (Text left, Form right) or stacked.
*   **Content Sections:**
    *   **Intro Text:** Explains the booking process (Select Service -> Select Doctor -> Confirm).
    *   **Booking Form (Blue Container):**
        *   Step indicators (1, 2, 3) at the top: "الخدمة" (Service), "اختيار الطبيب" (Choose Doctor), "التأكيد والدفع" (Confirm & Pay).
        *   Inputs: Dropdown for "القسم" (Department) and "اختيار الطبيب" (Choose Doctor).
        *   Button: "إرسال" (Submit).
*   **UI Elements:** Step progress indicators (circles connected by lines), form inputs inside a colored box.
*   **Colors:** Teal/Blue background for the form container to make it stand out.

### 10) Rating/Review Page (قيمنا)
*   **Layout:** Vertical form layout focused on feedback.
*   **Content Sections:**
    *   **Dropdown:** To select the "القسم" (Department) being rated.
    *   **Questions Section:**
        *   "النظافة" (Cleanliness): Rating options (Bad, Good, Excellent) using radio buttons or checkboxes.
        *   "هل الكادر كان سعيد؟" (Was the staff happy/friendly?): Rating options.
        *   "هل الكادر كان متعاون؟" (Was the staff cooperative?): Rating options.
    *   **Testimonial Section:** "البقاء تعليقاتك" (Leave your comments) - Textarea for detailed feedback.
    *   **Contact Info:** Fields for Name and Email.
    *   **Submit:** "إرسال التقييم" (Send Rating) button.
*   **UI Elements:** Radio buttons/Checkboxes for ratings, large textarea for comments.
*   **Colors:** White background, green checkmarks likely used for positive selection states (visible in screenshot).

---

### Global UI Characteristics
*   **Language:** Arabic (RTL Layout).
*   **Header:** Contains Logo (Clinic 9), Navigation Menu (Home, About, Services, Doctors, News, Contact), Search/Cart icons, and Phone number.
*   **Floating Elements:**
    *   **Promo Pop-up:** Persistent card in bottom-left offering a specific "2+2" deal.
    *   **WhatsApp Button:** Floating green button in bottom-right with "كلم الآن" (Chat now).
    *   **Social Sidebar:** Vertical strip on the right edge with icons for Instagram, YouTube, WhatsApp, Snapchat, TikTok.
*   **Footer:** Appears on all pages with copyright "Clinic 9 © 2025", phone number, and cookie policy link.
